title: Proper-score leaderboard on the untouched 2026 holdout; staking division empty
rule: rank by benchmark-relative proper score with a week-cluster lower bound and a Holm adjustment over the whole declared family. Raw win rate and ROI are not ranking metrics and are not shown as if they were.
benchmark: M0 climatology (training-window base rates, no team information)
block: 2026 weeks 1-10 (the final holdout; never used for selection)
shadows_only_reason: no model cleared the registered gate

staking_division.blank_reason: no officially sourced closing price exists in this repository for any 2026 market (data/price_policy.json)

rows.what_would_promote: a 2026 closing price with an official, timestamped source would open the staking division; sustained CLV above 0 over >= 8 weeks would promote to live
rows.what_would_retire: a negative 90% lower bound on benchmark-relative Brier skill over any rolling 4-week window, or a drift-alarm failure on the inputs twice in a row
